retrieved_sources.title: The role of augmentative and alternative communication for children with autism: current status and future trends

gioi_han: Keep actual study ages; pediatric and mixed adult findings cannot be generalized to every age from birth to 18.
No independent clinical appraisal; no individualized treatment or dosing inference.
Review of 17 systematic reviews, searches through March 2016; underlying evidence overlaps and many targets are requesting.
Do not infer speech suppression or guaranteed speech acquisition from aggregate AAC findings.

retrieved_sources.title: Autism Spectrum Social Stories in Schools Trial 2 (ASSSIST‐2): a pragmatic randomised controlled trial of the Social Stories™ intervention to address the social and emotional health of autistic children in UK primary schools

gioi_han: Primary intention-to-treat social responsiveness outcome was not statistically significant; individual socio-emotional goals improved.
Do not claim global social-skill, anxiety, depression or caregiver-stress improvement from individual-goal findings.
Social Stories are not PEERS and this trial does not reproduce a licensed PEERS treatment manual.
No independent clinical review; research/internal noncommercial use, no individual diagnosis or prescription.

retrieved_sources.title: Autism in Viet Nam: A systematic scoping review

gioi_han: 137-study scoping review; 87% conducted in Vietnam, others in diaspora contexts; underlying studies largely low quality.
Research perceptions of causes are not established causes of ASD. Historical legal/service statements require current primary Vietnamese verification.

PRISMA figure has internal count discrepancies (274 + 3688 differs from 3960; displayed database subtotals differ from displayed total). Preserve originals; do not silently reconcile or treat flow counts as verified quantitative evidence.
Supplement MMAT chart counts are criterion ratings, not independent study counts.
Source/provenance review only; no independent clinical appraisal.
